_comment: Overrides of flyllm/config_fly_llm_default.json for tests/test_fly.py. The data are small extracts of the v3 MABe files (first 5 videos x 2000 frames of usertrain_v3.npz and testtrain_v3.npz); datadir is relative to the repository. No filtering by fly category. Flip augmentation is on, as in the configs used for training.
